title: Tôi đưa nhầm hóa đơn cho bạn
englishTitle: I gave you the wrong bill
pronunciation: Toi dua nham hoa don cho ban
summary: For correcting a bill, receipt, or payment slip you handed over by mistake.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when the wrong paper, receipt, room bill, or payment slip is already in someone's hand.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the correct bill or receipt right after the phrase so the fix is obvious.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi đưa nhầm hóa đơn cho bạn
phrases.english: I gave you the wrong bill
phrases.pronunciation: Toi dua nham hoa don cho ban

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi đưa nhầm means I gave by mistake; hóa đơn cho bạn means the bill to you.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi đưa nhầm hóa đơn cho bạn
breakdown.english: I gave you the wrong bill

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Use this is not my receipt, wrong amount, or charged twice phrases when the mistake came from their side.

phrases.vietnamese: Biên lai này không phải của tôi
phrases.pronunciation: Bien lai nay khong phai cua toi

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi đã bị tính sai số tiền
phrases.english: I was charged the wrong amount
phrases.pronunciation: Toi da bi tinh sai so tien

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi bị tính tiền hai lần
phrases.pronunciation: toy bee ting tyen hai lun

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, shops, ticket counters, clinics, and restaurants before the mistake becomes a longer dispute.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep both bills visible if you can. Pointing is faster than explaining every line item.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Receipt, cancel the payment, refund, and write the price phrases cover the next repair step.
